rows.trigger: Immediate danger, urgent symptoms or time-critical protocol
rows.required_behavior: Route appropriate immediate support; suspend optional optimisation
rows.boundary: Always first; no sleep-on-it or readiness deferral
rows.status: H product precedence; clinical routes require specialist approval

rows.trigger: No guidance consent, revoked source, tenant mismatch, stale critical facts
rows.required_behavior: Stop prohibited processing; manual fallback only within remaining consent
rows.boundary: Never silently reacquire or infer withheld data

rows.trigger: Relevant contraindication, unknown higher-risk eligibility or affected practice causes distress
rows.required_behavior: Exclude practice; stop/escalate proportionately; offer reviewed low-risk alternative
rows.boundary: No score can offset an exclusion
rows.status: 10 CI registry; exact release approval required

rows.trigger: Sleep opportunity, unsafe driving or mandated emergency work
rows.required_behavior: Preserve sleep and prescribed/occupational protocol; no productivity optimisation of dangerous drowsiness
rows.boundary: No pre-dawn routine at cost of needed sleep

rows.trigger: Caregiving, deadline, meeting or compulsory shift
rows.required_behavior: Prepare/resize/change mode; include transition; protect subsequent recovery
rows.boundary: Do not mark unavoidable work as a lifestyle failure

rows.trigger: Quarantined, frontier, methods-only or unsupported biomedical bridge
rows.required_behavior: Exclude unwarranted prediction/benefit contribution; suspend disputed claims
rows.boundary: Metadata verification is not claim validation

rows.trigger: Life Compass focus conflicts with capacity or supporting need
rows.required_behavior: Explain tradeoff; offer smaller priority step or necessary recovery; user remains in control

rows.trigger: Action + preparation + transition must fit a real interval
rows.required_behavior: Select feasible variants; do not invent calendar availability; allow abstention
rows.boundary: Use elapsed time; no forced nominal ultradian90min

rows.trigger: Only actions passing all previous gates
rows.required_behavior: Versioned explicit fit features; default personal predictive weight zero; disclose ties/unknowns
rows.boundary: V2 weights are expert priors; no production calibration claimed

rows.required_behavior: Values shape chosen goal/practice; timing preference may resolve equal feasibility without causal claim
rows.boundary: No astrology health/money/career permit/deny; no spiritual score

rows.required_behavior: Plain reason, duration, tradeoff, uncertainty and alternative; record correction / stop / helpfulness separately
rows.boundary: Explanation must match actual gates; never generate a novel action
